scoring_justification: The zero-intercept slope is recomputed from the agent’s own (Δρ/ρ, strain) data; individual strain energies are compared to paper values with tolerance (T0).

hidden_assets.purpose: gold strain energies and zero-intercept slope
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Table 2 and Equation 2 (Inorg. Chem. 2018, DOI: 10.1021/acs.inorgchem.8b02038)
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: values are the paper’s own reported computed results for the hypothetical Zn(II) training set

outputs.description: Strain energies and deformation parameters for the five hypothetical Zn(II) complexes.

schema.description: A single float value (units: kJ mol⁻¹ per unit Δρ/ρ).

outputs.description: Zero‑intercept slope of ΔE_L(strain) vs Δρ/ρ_L(relax) from the training set of five ligands.

output_contract.notes: Values will be compared to hidden reference values derived from the paper with appropriate tolerances. Only the Zn(II) training set is required; CSD validation and Fe(II) application are excluded.
